name: Longer Laser B1 40W
tagline: 40W Longer's large-format diode : bigger bed than Ray5 for sign-sized projects
tldr: Longer Laser B1 40W is the 40W SKU on the Longer longer laser b1 line. Longer's large-format B1 20W diode : this profile is the 20W SKU only; Longer also sells 30W and 40W B1 machines separately. Verify optical power on the listing : do not assume combined-watt marketing.
mainObjective: Maximum cut speed and depth in the line : engraving remains strong at tuned speeds

priceRange.note: 40W optical module : verify SKU before buying

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Fastest B1 tier for thick soft-wood cutting in the Longer lineup
Large work area suits multi-up gift production
Strong value when you want speed without CO₂ ventilation projects
Worth pairing with quality air assist and exterior exhaust
cons: Frame and motion system work harder: maintain belts and focus
Clear acrylic and production signage still want CO₂
Open-frame safety rules apply at full power
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 40W module on Longer Laser B1. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Treat engraving and cutting as separate profiles. Push cut speeds only after test squares on your material. Compare CO₂ only when clear acrylic or all-day production enters the picture.

editorialDepth.advantages: B1 40W is for buyers already committed to Longer's large open frame who need maximum diode cutting on wood. Batch makers will feel the difference versus 20W on repeated 8 mm passes.
editorialDepth.limitations: Not a substitute for CO₂ acrylic shops. Fine photo work may look better on B1 20W with tuned speeds. Budget for exhaust upgrades when moving from Ray5.
